<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This pull request adds a connected-review runtime and workflow. The runtime checks pull-request eligibility, runs a constrained Claude review, validates and publishes findings, and reports outcomes. Replay and confinement tools, tests, setup guidance, and an architecture decision record accompany the workflow.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Security review details</summary>

**Security Findings and Attack Paths**
- _observed_ — The retained sensitive-data-exposure finding identifies review publication as the sink. Finder fields are checked for structure and anchors, but their text is copied into the review body or comments before POST without a secret-screening step.
- _inferred_ — PR content or repository material repeated in a finding can cross into the published review. The OAuth token is available to the CLI process, but available source does not show that restricted finder tools can read or reproduce it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Security review details</summary>

**Security Findings and Attack Paths**
- _observed_ — The retained sensitive-data-exposure finding identifies review publication as the sink. Finder fields are checked for structure and anchors, but their text is copied into the review body or comments before POST without a secret-screening step.
- _inferred_ — PR content or repository material repeated in a finding can cross into the published review. The OAuth token is available to the CLI process, but available source does not show that restricted finder tools can read or reproduce it.

</details>
